text.title: Pen Friends Chat
text.meta: Group chat · Madina, Yuki, Ali, Tom
paragraphs: Madina: Hi everyone! Welcome to our new chat. I am Madina. I am eleven. I am from Uzbekistan, so I am Uzbek. My **hometown** is Bukhara. It is very old and beautiful. Where are you from?
Yuki: Hello, Madina! I am Yuki. I am from Japan. I am Japanese. My hometown is Osaka. It is a big **city**. My school is near my home. Where is Bukhara? Is it **near** Tashkent?
Madina: No, it isn’t. Bukhara is in the west of Uzbekistan. Tashkent is the **capital**. Ali, where are you? Are you in Tashkent?
Ali: Hi, girls! I am Ali. I am Uzbek, but I am not in Uzbekistan now. I am in London with my family. London is the capital of England. It is very **famous**. My new friend Tom is here too.
Tom: Hello! I am Tom. I am from England, so I am English. My favourite **country** is Uzbekistan. Ali’s photos of Samarkand are amazing! Where is the best plov? Is it in Bukhara?

mcq.q: What is the capital of Uzbekistan?
Who is Ali with in London?

about_you: What country do you want to visit?
